source.snippet: Ollama on Windows already downloads updates automatically in the background, but installing them still requires the user to manually click 'Restart to update' in the tray menu. I would like this final step to also happen automatically, with the restart deferred while a model is currently loaded.

problem_statement: Local AI inference tools on Windows require manual intervention to complete updates, interrupting workflows and leaving non-technical users on stale, potentially less secure versions.
target_segment: Windows-based knowledge workers and small business users running Ollama or similar local AI tools without dedicated IT support
notes: Single feature request; weak standalone signal. Combined with the concurrency issue above, points to a broader gap: managed local LLM deployment tooling for non-DevOps users. Low buyer signal on its own.
